notes: «عن الحكم، وسلمة بن كهيل عن سعيد بن جبير»: both Hakam and Salama narrate from Sa'id, one level

after Sa'id the report goes on «ثم حدث عن ابن عمر أنه صلى مثل ذلك» and «وحدث ابن عمر أن النبي ... صنع مثل ذلك»: Ibn Umar is read as the next link, but the second statement carries its own transmission (rule 11: two sayings in one report), so the ruling is open
the Prophet is the end and is not a link
